entries.mechanism: exact upstream prebuilt archive verified by GitHub release SHA-256 digest; supply-chain workflow reads this registry
entries.reason: the official cargo-deny Action downloads its runtime binary without a checksum; keep the stronger verified-artifact contract until an equally verifiable maintained integration exists
entries.revisit_trigger: new stable cargo-deny release, security advisory, maintained checksum-verifying integration, or review deadline

entries.mechanism: exact upstream prebuilt archives verified by GitHub release SHA-256 digests; installers read this registry and cache identity includes the pinned version
entries.reason: sccache participates in the protected-main compiler-cache producer/consumer contract; an upgrade must rotate cache identity and prove restore/prime compatibility before merge
entries.revisit_trigger: new stable sccache release, security advisory, cache-format incompatibility, or review deadline

entries.mechanism: exact upstream ARM64 archive verified by GitHub release SHA-256 digest; installer reads this registry and cache identity includes the pinned version
entries.reason: mold is part of the ARM64 linker/cache execution contract; linker changes require cache rotation and compiler/linker validation rather than silent runtime drift
entries.revisit_trigger: new stable mold release, linker/security regression, cache contract change, or review deadline

entries.mechanism: exact upstream release archive verified by GitHub release SHA-256 digest; protected release installer reads this registry
entries.reason: cargo-cyclonedx changes release SBOM output and therefore release evidence; upgrades require explicit output-format/package-content review before becoming the protected tag producer
entries.revisit_trigger: new stable cargo-cyclonedx release, SBOM/security advisory, release-format requirement, or review deadline

entries.mechanism: architecture-independent ordinary x64 jobs use the supported ubuntu-latest production alias
entries.revisit_trigger: GitHub changes the ubuntu-latest production alias contract

entries.mechanism: ARM64 jobs use the newest GA architecture-specific label because GitHub provides no equivalent moving ubuntu-latest ARM alias
entries.reason: there is no supported moving ARM64 Ubuntu alias; explicit GA migration must be validated across tool/cache and CodeQL contracts before changing the shared architecture lane
entries.revisit_trigger: new GA ARM64 Ubuntu image, GitHub ARM moving alias, runner deprecation/security notice, or review deadline

entries.authority: upstream PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, MariaDB, and Microsoft SQL Server image registries/release notes
entries.mechanism: certification matrix changes are reviewed together with exact image digests, expected product versions, fixture contracts, and database-specific tests
entries.reason: database images are certified compatibility inputs rather than implementation dependencies; changing a patch/CU changes the product-version claim and must not silently rewrite the tested support matrix
entries.revisit_trigger: database security advisory, supported-line patch/CU refresh, certification milestone, or review deadline

entries.mechanism: campaign evidence workflows stay on an explicit reviewed runner image while ordinary non-evidence x64 CI uses ubuntu-latest
entries.reason: M5/M6 evidence producers bind execution contracts to the reviewed runner image; changing the image changes certification conditions and requires contract/evidence review
entries.revisit_trigger: runner deprecation/security notice, evidence refresh, certification milestone, or review deadline
